text:
Maria Lopez: Hey everyone — People Ops just published a single-sheet OKR + self-review template for the upcoming performance cycle. Link: https://redwood.docs.internal/people/okr-selfreview-v1 (please don't share externally). Can you skim and give feedback by EOD Friday? :sparkles:
Jen Park: thanks! do we want team OKRs only or individual objectives too?
Maria Lopez: Great q. We want both. Team OKRs should be top-level; individuals should align to 1–3 objectives that map to team OKRs. Keep KR counts small (2–4 per objective).
Samir Patel: Example to help folks:
Samir Patel: Objective: "Improve model inference cost-efficiency"
Samir Patel: KRs: 1) Reduce per-token GPU spend by 18% via batching + quantization, 2) Deploy prefix cache for top-10 routes, 3) Ship benchmarks showing no >2% quality regression.
Jen Park: Nice. For self-reviews, do we ask for evidence/examples or just ratings?
Maria Lopez: Ask for both. Template has these fields: accomplishments (bulleted with links), biggest learnings, blockers still unresolved, impact examples (metrics where possible), and manager feedback requested. We also include a quick 1–5 calibration rating checkbox.
Nick Huang: How will calibration work? managers at different levels need to sync otherwise scores drift.
Maria Lopez: We'll run manager calibration sessions during week 2 of reviews. People Ops will send calibration guides + anonymized examples. Managers should bring 3–5 writeups for discussion.
Jen Park: Any guidance for writing measurable KRs for fuzzy work (e.g., "improve reliability")?
Samir Patel: Tip: convert to proxies — error budget reductions, MTTR target, reduction in P99 spikes, or number of runbook automations shipped.
Maria Lopez: Added a short manager cheat-sheet in the doc for coaching phrasing and how to push back constructively on self-reviews. Example phrasing: "I appreciate the initiative on X; to strengthen this KR, can you add a measurable metric and timeline?"
Jen Park: Can we get an automated reminder to teams 3 days before the deadline?
OKR-bot: Reminder set — initial objective submissions due 2026-04-10 17:00 UTC. Will post reminders @here 3 days and 24 hours before.
Nick Huang: Cool. One last thing — can we get a short workshop for ICs on "writing effective KR metrics"?
Maria Lopez: Yes — scheduling a 45min drop-in the week before submissions. I'll post calendar invite once time is finalized. Thanks for the quick review everyone :raised_hands:
